name: sovereign_inspect_archive
description: Streams and inspects .hdx, .hwics, .zip, .xlsx, .docx, .tar.zst, or .epub containers purely in-memory (O_RDONLY, zero disk extraction) per ADR-07. Also supports section/offset slicing (section_filter, char_offset) and zero-reindex corpus path relocation / stale relationship cleanup (action='relocate_prefix' | 'purge_prefix' | 'corpus_stats').

action.description: Operation mode: 'inspect' (default), 'relocate_prefix' (re-point archive:// URIs & rebuild clean graph edges without re-indexing), 'purge_prefix' (delete records & relationships for an old prefix), or 'corpus_stats'

archive_path.description: Path to the archive container (.hdx, .hwics, .zip, .tar.zst, .epub) to inspect

virtual_uri.description: Optional canonical virtual URI (archive://<archive_path>#<entry_name>) to resolve directly in-memory

section_filter.description: Optional section heading filter (e.g. 'Possible Causes', 'Procedure', 'Parameters') to extract that exact section without Python slicing

char_offset.description: Optional character start offset when reading a long archive entry

max_chars.description: Maximum characters to return from the resolved archive entry

old_prefix.description: Old directory/URI prefix to relocate or purge (e.g. '/tmp/docs_rag_gemini')

new_prefix.description: New directory/URI prefix to point existing indexed records and graph relationships to (e.g. '/home/tlima/Enterprise_Hub/docs/Hua_Docs')

clear_stale_relationships.description: When relocating or purging, clear orphaned/stale GraphStore edges referencing the old path

enrich_deep_alarms.description: When relocating Huawei .hwics packages, stream resources/alarms/*.html in-memory from new_prefix to persist full 18k-char Possible Causes & Procedures

extract_diagram_to_artifact.description: When true, extracts embedded PNG signaling ladder / root-alarm diagrams (class='vsd' or direct .png virtual_uri) from the .hwics/.zip container in-memory and saves them to artifact_output_dir

artifact_output_dir.description: Optional directory path to save extracted PNG diagrams (defaults to dev/aegis-sovereign-appliance/data/extracted_diagrams)

query.description: Optional keyword or alarm code filter to match against archive entries

ingest.description: Whether to ingest matched archive entries into the knowledge graph
